summary: Landstar System, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting entry into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on June 30, 2026, amending its existing revolving credit facility. The new facility provides an initial $300 million revolving line with an accordion feature for up to $500 million in additional increases, maturing June 30, 2031. No borrowings were outstanding at closing. The unsecured obligations are guaranteed by substantially all domestic subsidiaries, with a pledge of up to 65% voting stock of foreign subsidiaries as alternative collateral. The agreement contains financial covenants including minimum interest coverage and maximum net leverage ratios. This routine bank credit facility refinancing does not constitute a special situation.
